Gallium-67 Galio 67. CAS — 14119-09-6. ATC — V09HX01 (gallium citrate (67Ga)). ATC Vet — QV09HX01 (gallium citrate (67Ga)). HALF-LIFE. 3.26 days. Profile Gallium-67 is used in the form of an intravenous injection of gal- lium citrate (67Ga). Gallium citrate (67Ga) is concentrated in some malignant tu- mours of the lymphatic system, as well as in some other tissues, and is used for tumour visualisation. Concentration also occurs in inflammatory lesions and the injection is therefore used for the localisation of focal inflammatory sites, such as may occur in ab- scesses, osteomyelitis, or sarcoidosis. Gallium scans have proved useful for the detection of the various infections and ma- lignancies that may be encountered in patients with AIDS. Breast feeding. The American Academy of Pediatrics has stated1 that temporary cessation of breast feeding is required after exposure to gallium-67 since radioactivity has been reported to be present in breast milk for 2 weeks. 1.
